verdict.rationale: Org SSO with SAML is a fair question for a team SaaS product like Trello, but the evidence pack has no first-party documentation of SAML or organization SSO configuration. The related items cover other things and earn no credit: Google social login (trello-comm-15), domain-based managed-account migration (trello-comm-28), a passing user mention of 'Atlassian SSO 2FA' (trello-comm-29), and API OAuth tokens for developers.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can secure organization access with SSO and SAML
